consumer_profile.shared_component: IA-D04-002 Proposal and Approval Shared Component
consumer_profile.action_loop: MV-IA-F006 First Playable Action and GM Approval Loop

blind_mode_definition: A player constructs and submits a syntactically valid Rune Construction without receiving the interpreted/resolved magical effect before GM adjudication. The server resolves the construction through the same deterministic grammar and owning-rule adapters used by standard play, projects the resolved effect only to authorized GM/Assistant-GM decision-makers, and commits nothing unless an authorized final decision succeeds.

visible: player-selected rune glyphs and any rune names the player is already permitted to know
canonical linear serialization of the submitted construction
connection topology and declared modifiers that originated from the player
player-declared targets that are visible and selectable to that player
syntax validity and non-semantic parser errors
structural edit warnings that do not decode the effect
the player's own known resource commitments when owning rules permit them to know those values
hidden_until_policy_allows: resolved effect family or spell-like outcome
predicted damage, healing, condition, movement, summon, banishment, control, drain, dispel or other final mutation
final approval likelihood or AI prediction of GM decision

required_evidence_slots: campaign scene session and snapshot identities
original visual construction and canonical linear serialization
range area duration timing trigger condition and shape
resolved owning-rule resource adapters and costs
resistance counterspell disruption and other counterplay hooks
crafting inscription or item-binding fields when applicable
validation warnings ambiguity findings and unresolved required adapters
source provenance rule references and setting-local scope
predicted authoritative Effects Resources Conditions movement target-state and other mutations
proposal actor target session permission entitlement pack schema and rule versions
stale conflict revocation and compatibility findings

decision_contract.approve: Revalidate current authority, versions, resources, targets, counterplay and effect schema; if valid, atomically commit the reviewed resolved effect.
decision_contract.deny: Record attributable denial and user-safe reason; commit no rune costs or Effects unless an owning rule explicitly defines a separate attempt cost that was already authorized and represented before submission.
decision_contract.modify-and-approve: Preserve the immutable player construction and original resolved proposal, record exact changed fields/original/final values/reasons, revalidate the modified result, require explicit final confirmation, then atomically commit the modified approved result.
allowed_modification_classes: resolved target set within authorized candidate targets
resource or cost result where owning rules permit GM adjudication
decision_contract.rune_expression_rewrite_rule: A GM may not silently replace the player's submitted rune expression. If the expression itself is changed, the decision must record the original expression, final GM-adjusted expression and reason as a semantic modification; history must never attribute the changed expression to the player.

postdecision_player_projection.rule: The player receives only the post-resolution information permitted by Campaign/Session reveal policy and current perception/knowledge permissions. Blind mode does not force full mechanical decoding after resolution.

offline_and_recovery.ambiguous_submit_or_decision: Query current status with the original operationId/decisionId before retrying.
